name: Smith Argus
summary: Smith Argus is the resident blacksmith and trainer stationed in the heart of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. From his open-air forge near the Lion's Pride Inn, he repairs traveler gear, teaches novice smiths their fundamentals, and coordinates with craftsmen across southern Azeroth. His network ties Goldshire's local trade directly to logistical hubs like Stormwind and distant frontiers like Redridge.

sections.title: The Anvil of Goldshire
sections.body: Situated just outside the Lion's Pride Inn, Smith Argus maintains one of the busiest anvils in Elwynn Forest. While Goldshire faces growing perils from nearby gnolls, kobolds, and Defias bandits, Argus keeps local militia and passing adventurers properly equipped. In addition to mending dented armor and forging sturdy implements, he serves as a blacksmithing trainer, initiating fledgling craftsmen into the fundamentals of working copper and bronze.

sections.title: Inter-Town Trade and Demands
sections.body: Argus is not an isolated village smith; his workshop is a vital link in the Kingdom of Stormwind's regional supply chain. When craftsmen in neighboring settlements require specialized gear or raw materials, they look to Goldshire's central position. Farrier Verner Osgood in Redridge relies on Argus for shipments of crafted horseshoes to keep pack animals and cavalry moving, while metalworkers in Stormwind's Dwarven District regularly coordinate deliveries through him.

faq.q: Where can I find Smith Argus?
faq.answer: Smith Argus is located in Goldshire in central Elwynn Forest. You can find him working at the outdoor anvil and forge set up behind the armor shop, near the Lion's Pride Inn.

faq.q: What services does Smith Argus provide?
faq.answer: Argus teaches novice blacksmiths the fundamentals of the craft. His Classic title is Journeyman Blacksmith.

faq.q: Why does a blacksmith in Redridge send me to Smith Argus?
faq.answer: Verner Osgood, a craftsman in Lakeshire, has a high demand for horseshoes to keep supply wagons and mounts moving against the Blackrock orc threat. He contracts Argus in Goldshire to forge and supply the necessary iron footwear.

faq.q: What is Argus's connection to Stormwind City?
faq.answer: Argus coordinates supply runs with dwarven smiths in Stormwind City, such as Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District.

faq.q: Can Smith Argus train advanced or expert blacksmithing?
faq.answer: Argus teaches the early stages of blacksmithing; advanced techniques require more experienced masters in larger settlements.

faq.q: Does Smith Argus belong to any particular guild?
faq.answer: Argus is a loyal subject of the Kingdom of Stormwind and a member of the local craftsmen community serving the Alliance in Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: For Alliance characters starting in Elwynn, Argus is often the very first teacher of the forge, providing initial recipes for rough copper gear and essential utility items.
Miners bring metal to Goldshire's forge, where Argus teaches aspiring blacksmiths to work it into useful implements.
Argus represents the hardworking tradesmen who keep Elwynn running despite the kingdom's broader political neglect and bandit unrest.
